_comment: Only text this repository does not own may be excluded here, and nothing currently qualifies. CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md is adapted from Contributor Covenant v2.1 under CC BY 4.0 and is maintained as this organization's own policy, so it is audited and edited like every other file. .claude/rules/pr-body-contract.md is sync-managed from melodic-software/standards; it stays in scope so findings there are filed upstream, never edited here. The em-dash rule is zero-tolerance on every file. Before adding a path to either list, name whose text it is and why it cannot be changed here.
